part.text:
Fixed `blockingGenericZpopCommand` to block only on the actual parsed zset keys (`keys`/`numkeys`) instead of slicing raw command arguments, which had included timeout/numkeys/MIN/MAX/COUNT tokens.

Validated with the container build and full `unit/type/zset` suite: all tests pass, including `BZMPOP should not blocks on non key arguments - #10762`.
